_readme: Mode-A overlap eval for the LLM peer generator (directives/peer_selection_llm.md). Score = RECALL of `expected_peers` (the must-have business-model comps a fundamental analyst would expect); a case passes at recall >= 0.5. `also_valid` are correct-but-not-required alternatives counted only in the reported precision, never required. business_description is answer-neutral (never names a peer) so it can't leak the expected set. sector/industry are the same GICS-ish hints the production call passes. Re-run: python execution/run_llm_evals.py --purpose peer_selection --min-score 0.6

cases.name: Nu Holdings
cases.business_description: A branchless, app-only digital financial-services platform serving retail consumers across Latin America. Acquires customers at near-zero marginal cost through a mobile app, monetizes via interchange, a fast-growing unsecured-lending book, and net interest income on low-cost deposits. The bet is consumer-banking disruption of high-fee incumbent banks through a low-cost-to-serve technology model.

cases.name: ServiceNow
cases.business_description: An enterprise software-as-a-service platform selling a cloud workflow/automation suite to large organizations on a recurring subscription basis. Lands with IT service management and expands across the enterprise with high net revenue retention; growth is seat- and module-expansion driven with strong operating leverage.

cases.name: MercadoLibre
cases.business_description: A Latin American online marketplace bundled with a payments and digital-financial-services arm. Monetizes through marketplace take rate, advertising, logistics, and payment processing plus a growing consumer-credit book — an e-commerce-plus-fintech flywheel in emerging markets.

cases.name: Uber Technologies
cases.business_description: A multi-sided on-demand marketplace matching consumers with drivers and couriers for ride-hailing and food/grocery delivery, taking a percentage of gross bookings. Network-effects and density economics drive margins; monetization expands through advertising and subscriptions.

cases.name: Meta Platforms
cases.business_description: A consumer social-media company that monetizes attention almost entirely through targeted digital advertising sold against a large engaged user base. Revenue scales with ad impressions and pricing; an AI-driven ranking/targeting stack is the core competitive moat.

cases.name: Veeva Systems
cases.business_description: A vertical software-as-a-service vendor selling industry-specific cloud applications (CRM, content and data management) to a single regulated end-market on recurring subscriptions. Deep domain specialization and switching costs drive durable retention; growth is cross-sell of new cloud modules into the installed base.

cases.name: CrowdStrike Holdings
cases.business_description: A cloud-native cybersecurity platform delivering endpoint and broader security protection via a single lightweight agent on a recurring per-endpoint subscription. Land-and-expand module attach drives net retention; a data/telemetry network effect strengthens detection as the customer base grows.

cases.name: Shopify
cases.business_description: A commerce-enablement platform that lets merchants run their own online stores, monetizing through SaaS subscriptions plus payments, capital, and fulfilment attached to merchant gross merchandise volume. Take-rate expansion on rising GMV is the growth engine.

cases.name: Snowflake
cases.business_description: A cloud data platform sold on consumption-based pricing — customers pay for storage and compute as they query and process data. Net revenue retention is driven by rising data workloads; the moat is data gravity and an expanding application/marketplace ecosystem.

cases.name: Airbnb
cases.business_description: An online travel marketplace matching guests with hosts of short-term accommodation, taking a service fee on each booking. Asset-light, supply is user-generated; growth is driven by listings, nights booked, and pricing, with a strong direct-traffic brand reducing customer-acquisition cost.
